notes: 8286472 (CN 12587380, CAN 16994904) is a contract-counter notice, the 5051007 shape: LOT_NUMBER = CONTRACT_NO 1..17 while the titles say "zadanie 1..8, 10..18" (lot 9 and 19 unawarded). RES-1..8 are right by coincidence, RES-9..17 sit one lot low. G4 (notice) refuses all 17: 9/9 wrong caught, 8 coincidental rights lost (decision risk 3).

New G3 keyword false-positive shape (no net effect here, G4 already refuses the notice): the count phrase "(pakiet N pozycji/pozycje)" = "a package of N items" reads as designator Pakiet N. With "zadanie k" it gives |Dn| = 2 on RES-4 (pakiet 8, zadanie 4), RES-5 (6, 5) and RES-8 (3, 8), all right blocks. In each case the extra number is also in the matched lot's own CN title "(pakiet N pozycji)", which G4 already credits but G3 does not.
5439807 F06 award notices 19223648/19225856/19377201/19483641 carry their own lot sections (567 same-notice keys) and are out of the 568 scope; not labelled.
